CreditPrices.description:
Typical (display-only) credit prices so the UI never hard-codes them. Jobs are metered by
AI usage (``CREDITS_TYPICAL_*`` in .env); ``signup_bonus`` is the real grant.
CreditPrices.title: CreditPrices

Metering.description: Token-metered pricing facts for the billing page (docs/token-metered-billing.md §6).
Metering.title: Metering

OwnerUsage.description:
Platform-owner only: metered credits over the last 30 days, billed (tied to a paying job)
vs unbilled (background work nobody is charged for), and the provider cost.
OwnerUsage.title: OwnerUsage

Receipt.description:
A job's credit receipt (review, chat, finishing touch, security review): hold, final
charge, returned part and per-stage lines. All amounts are whole credits (decimal strings
without a fractional part, e.g. ``"285"``).
Receipt.title: Receipt

ReceiptLine.description:
Credits one pipeline stage used, in whole credits (the lines add up to ``charged``).
Token / $ fields are owner-only (``INTERNAL_FIELDS``).
ReceiptLine.title: ReceiptLine

UsageSource.description: Unbilled LLM work of one kind (learnings, reports, post-merge, ...).
UsageSource.title: UsageSource

get.description:
The double-submit CSRF token in the body (the dashboard is a separate origin and cannot
read the API's cookie); sets the cookie when missing. Mutations echo it in X-CSRF-Token.

Start OAuth. With an existing session this links the identity to the signed-in user.

The ``state`` is bound to this browser by a random nonce kept in a short-lived HttpOnly
cookie; the callback refuses a state whose nonce does not match (login CSRF / identity
hijack via a forwarded authorize URL).

post.description: Join (and on first use create) an org the user belongs to on the provider.

Release an abandoned checkout so it stops counting against the purchase caps.

Only an unpaid ``created`` order is touched; if Razorpay still captures it later, the
webhook's ``fulfill`` grants it (clamped to the caps) since it only skips ``paid`` rows.

get.description:
Credit receipt of one metered job (review, chat, change_stack_chat, finishing,
security_scan) of this org; token / $ fields only for platform owners.
Newest first. ``review_id`` lists the jobs of that review's pull request.

post.description: Connect to the server (from the API process, SSRF-guarded) and cache its tool list.

schema.title: Response Sync Api Orgs  Org Slug  Repos Sync Post

get.description: Repo + org UI settings merged like a review would (without the repo's .hootpr.yaml).

post.description: Surface maps are free (any member); security reviews cost credits (admins only).
